chunks: And whatever was in it from ‘Abd Allāh ibn Jablah, I have narrated it from my father, and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, and Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with them—from ‘Abd Allāh ibn Ja‘far al-Ḥimyarī, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbār, from ‘Abd Allāh ibn Jablah.

key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: Al-Ḥimyarī; a nisbah identifying a narrator in the chain.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal expression of hadith narration.
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ: The narrator to whom this transmission chain leads.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: From my father; part of the immediate transmission link.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ‘Abd Allāh ibn Jablah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the transmission chain through which the author narrates reports from ‘Abd Allāh ibn Jablah. Its significance is in documenting the sanad/isnad and preserving the source pathway for hadith transmission in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
